features: 350FT / 100M Wireless Range — Stream Anywhere in Your Home or Office The ETZIN wireless HDMI extender delivers a stable, long-range signal up to 350 feet (100 meters) through walls, floors, and ceilings. Eliminate cable clutter and freely position your display anywhere — perfect for home theaters, conference rooms, classrooms, retail signage, and large open spaces. No dead zones, no signal drops.

Crystal-Clear 1080P Full HD — Zero Compression, Zero Blur Experience sharp, true-to-life 1080P Full HD video and lossless audio wirelessly transmitted in real time. The ABS dongle adapter preserves every detail with minimal latency, making it ideal for streaming movies, watching sports, gaming, video conferencing, and slideshow presentations without any degradation in picture quality.

2.4G / 5G Dual Band — Auto-Switch for Interference-Free Performance Equipped with dual-band 2.4GHz and 5GHz wireless technology, the ETZIN extender automatically selects the cleanest frequency for your environment. The 5GHz band offers faster speeds and less congestion in Wi-Fi-dense areas like apartments or offices, while 2.4GHz provides superior wall-penetrating range. No buffering, no interference.

True Plug & Play — No Wi-Fi Network, No App, No Configuration Simply connect the transmitter to your source device and the receiver to your display — the units pair automatically within seconds. No router, no app, no software, no passwords required. Works straight out of the box with any HDMI-equipped device. Ideal for quick meeting room setups, travel, on-site presentations, and non-technical users.

Universal Compatibility — Works with All HDMI Devices Compatible with TV boxes, Blu-ray players, DVD players, laptops, PCs, desktops, gaming consoles (PS4/PS5/Xbox), set-top boxes, cable boxes, streaming sticks, and projectors. Output to any HDMI-enabled TV, monitor, or projector. Supports HDCP content protection for seamless streaming of protected media.

Synchronized HD Audio Transmission — Full Surround Sound Wirelessly Transmits not just video — full HD audio is wirelessly synced alongside the video signal, with no lip-sync delay. Enjoy stereo, surround sound, and digital audio from your source device to your display or sound system, completely wire-free. No separate audio cables needed.
description: No routers. No apps. No IT support required. Connect the transmitter to your source (TV box, laptop, gaming console, streaming device) and the receiver to your display. They pair automatically — you're streaming in seconds.
